name: Lucia
source:
Mother of Sarah. She is a maternal and gentle lady, that nevertheless has a strong sense of justice. She was given a daughter by a god for defeating an evil deity, and is thus a virgin.

Although retired, she is still considered to be the strongest warrior in the world, and is the rival of the Demon King.
